articles.summary: UDR, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: UDR ), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, today announced that Scott McCallum will join the Company as Executive Vice President - Chief Investment Officer (“EVP-CIO”), effective November 5, 2026. He will report to Thomas W. Toomey, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of UDR. articles.summary: UDR, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: UDR), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 2, 2026, after the market closes. A webcast and conference call will be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The webcast and conference call will be open to the public.
